user_question: Summarize mean elevation for the census tracts that intersect State College borough.

workflow_plan.goal: Summarize mean elevation for the census tracts that intersect State College borough.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve State College borough boundary
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a candidate polygon boundary for State College borough to identify intersecting census tracts.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve the best available registered dataset candidate representing the State College borough boundary. Preserve the returned artifact metadata for runtime suitability checks.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject borough boundary to tract CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform the retrieved borough boundary into the census tract CRS so the spatial intersection operation has compatible coordinate systems.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the retrieved borough boundary to EPSG:26918. Do not assign a CRS or infer a source CRS; runtime QC must confirm the candidate has a known source CRS before reprojection.

workflow_steps.title: Identify census tracts intersecting State College borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Select the census tract polygons whose geometries intersect the State College borough boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform a spatial intersection join between the census tract layer and the reprojected borough boundary. Retain the census tract polygon features that intersect the borough. Preserve the tract identifiers and geometries; do not guess or hard-code field names.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject intersecting tracts to DEM CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform the selected tract zones into the DEM CRS for zonal statistics.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the selected intersecting tract polygons to EPSG:3857, matching the DEM CRS. Preserve tract identifiers and polygon geometry.

workflow_steps.title: Compute mean elevation by intersecting census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Calculate mean DEM elevation for each census tract that intersects State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Compute zonal statistics using the DEM raster and the selected intersecting tract polygons. Produce one output record per tract with its mean elevation and preserve available tract identifiers. Use the mean statistic; do not guess field names.
